blocks.text: Sales CRM with visual pipeline management built for closers

Pipedrive was built by salespeople frustrated with CRMs designed by engineers. The result is a pipeline-first tool that makes the sales process visual and activity-driven. Instead of tracking data for the sake of tracking, Pipedrive focuses on the activities that actually close deals.

The visual pipeline is the core experience. Drag deals between stages, see your entire pipeline at a glance, and get prompted for next activities based on deal stage and history. This activity-based approach keeps sales teams focused on selling rather than administrating their CRM.

The AI Sales Assistant analyzes your patterns and provides suggestions - which deals need attention, what activities to prioritize, and where opportunities are at risk. For sales managers, it provides coaching insights without micromanaging.
Drag-and-drop deal management with customizable stages
Focus on sales activities that drive deals forward
AI-powered suggestions for deal prioritization and next actions
Two-way sync, templates, and tracking built in
Workflow automation for deal routing, task creation, and notifications
Pipeline analytics, forecasting, and team performance dashboards

For pure sales execution - managing pipeline, closing deals, keeping activities on track - Pipedrive is the most focused and least bloated option. It does sales CRM well and does not try to be an everything platform.
Our team can integrate Pipedrive into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
